video_title: De’Anthony Melton recaps big night in Warriors’ win vs. Kings | NBC Sports BA

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams' impact on the Warriors' bench rotation
quotes.excerpt: He do so many great things on the court and especially in transition and his speed

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Brandon Williams made his debut tonight, coming back from his injury. How good is it for your bench to have that boost coming in a game?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: That's my dog right there. He do so many great things on the court and especially in transition and his speed and quickness to get to the rim. I don't think there's too many people really stopping him getting there. It's just about making layups and he made seven of them today, so he's just exceptional.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on Brandon Williams after his debut: That is my dog right there. He does so many great things on the court and especially in transition. I do not think there are too many people really stopping him from getting to the rim.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton discusses the impact of Brandon Williams returning from injury in the Warriors' win against the Kings.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' philosophy on defending home court after road trips
quotes.excerpt: We got to protect home court no matter what, so I think we're doing a great job

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Two games back-to-back at home, two wins. What's been the philosophy coming back home after a tough road trip?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: This little skid we had, we felt like we was getting punched in the mouth, so we wanted to come out here and just start punching first and get more discipline on both sides of the ball. We got to protect home court no matter what, so I think we're doing a great job of that. Now it's just about continuing this run and keep it going.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors recent home wins: We felt like we were getting punched in the mouth, so we wanted to come out here and just start punching first and get more discipline on both sides of the ball.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton explains the Warriors' mindset regarding defending their home court after returning from a road trip.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' ball movement and high-quality shot selection
quotes.excerpt: We tweaked a couple things that people were kind of scouting on us

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You guys get 37 assists on 49 buckets and 20 made threes as a team. Talk about the catch and shoot threes, because that tells me the ball is moving.

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: We tweaked a couple things that people were kind of scouting on us. We changed a couple things and also we were just sticking to our game plan and just making sure the ball was moving as long as our bodies. We trying to keep the defense honest and just keep them in misdirection.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors ball movement: We tweaked a couple things that people were scouting on us. We were just sticking to our game plan and making sure the ball was moving as long as our bodies to keep the defense honest.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton explains the adjustments the Warriors made to their offensive ball movement and shot selection.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Adjusting the Warriors' rotation during Stephen Curry's absence
quotes.excerpt: When he's off the court, we got to just make sure we maintain the lead

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: A big conversation has been the non-Steph minutes. How do you guys view this period right now that you're playing without Steph in the lineup?

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: When he's in the game, he's going to do so many great things for us that when he's off the court, we got to just make sure we maintain the lead and sometimes when we're winning, even grow the lead. So we're just trying to figure it out when he's not on the floor and I think we're coming around that corner with it.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on playing without Steph Curry: When he is off the court, we have to just make sure we maintain the lead and sometimes when we are winning, even grow the lead. We are just trying to figure it out.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton discusses how the Warriors are managing their rotation and maintaining leads while Stephen Curry is out of the lineup.

quotes.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
quotes.summary_phrase: Depth and next-man-up mentality on the Warriors' roster
quotes.excerpt: I think that's the beauty of this team, we got so much depth and so much confidence

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Tonight the bench had 61 points to Sacramento's 19. Talk about the contribution from your bench tonight.

text_blocks.speaker: De’Anthony Melton
text_blocks.text: I've been saying it since day one, how much depth we got. I think anybody on this team can really go. The dudes that's not even really playing can still go. I think that's the beauty of this team, we got so much depth and so much confidence that anybody that steps up, it's always next man up for sure.

quotes.social_post: De Anthony Melton on the Warriors bench depth: I have been saying it since day one, how much depth we have. I think anybody on this team can really go. It is always next man up for sure.

structured.context: De’Anthony Melton praises the depth of the Warriors' roster following a high-scoring performance from the bench against the Kings.
